# What does federal excise tax really cost your distillery per bottle?

> Free federal spirits excise tax calculator for craft distillers: enter bottles and their proof, see proof gallons, the CBMA $2.70 and $13.34 tax, the cost per bottle and pour, and what growing past 100,000 proof gallons does. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
